description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979 - Postal Services
categorisation: This gazette content is an order by the President declaring certain postal services as essential services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It establishes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for these services, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on the legal authority and regulatory declaration rather than naming individuals with portfolio responsibilities or describing organizational changes.
